# GrabbableGripRule

**Class** · namespace `VRFramework.Core.Editors.Validation` · assembly `VRFramework.Core.Editors` · [view source](https://git.cie-group.cz/vr-framework/vrf4/core/-/blob/interaction/physics-hold/Editor/Validation/Rules/GripRules.cs#L19)

Checks the grip model on every grabbable in the open scene: how it may be taken, by which
colliders, and where hands attach.

Every finding here was a real headset session first. A grabbable holds several settings that
cannot disagree with each other and are not obviously related in the inspector - an object that
needs two hands but forbids the second, gripPoints that the hold is configured to ignore, a
whitelist naming colliders that belong to something else. None of them throw, so the object
simply behaves in a way its author did not ask for, and finding out costs a headset.
